description: This Java class models a product option value within an e-commerce system. It includes fields for identifiers, sorting order, images, display options, codes, descriptions, and associations to merchant stores. It uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping and Hibernate validation.

classes.name: ProductOptionValue
classes.description: Represents a value for a product option, including properties such as image, code, display order, descriptions, and associated merchant store.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this product option value.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this product option value.

methods.name: getProductOptionValueSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the display sort order of the product option value.

methods.name: setProductOptionValueSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the display sort order of the product option value.

methods.name: getProductOptionValueImage
methods.description: Returns the image associated with this product option value.

methods.name: setProductOptionValueImage
methods.description: Sets the image associated with this product option value.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of descriptions for this product option value.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the descriptions for this product option value.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with this product option value.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with this product option value.

methods.name: setDescriptionsList
methods.description: Sets the list of descriptions for this product option value.

methods.name: getDescriptionsList
methods.description: Returns the list of descriptions for this product option value.

methods.name: getDescriptionsSettoList
methods.description: Returns the descriptions as a list, converting from the set if necessary.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image file for this product option value.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Retrieves the image file for this product option value.

methods.name: isProductOptionDisplayOnly
methods.description: Checks if the product option value is display-only.

methods.name: setProductOptionDisplayOnly
methods.description: Sets whether the product option value is display-only.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code for this product option value.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code for this product option value.
